quote.text: How cruel it is not to allow a man to strive after the things which appear to them to be suitable to their nature and profitable! And yet in a manner thou dost not allow them to do this, when thou art vexed because they do wrong. For they are certainly moved towards things because they suppose them to be suitable to their nature and profitable to them - But it is not so - Teach them, then, and show them without being angry.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that each child is naturally drawn to pursue what they see as good for themselves; gently guide them rather than suppress their intuition.
    • When missteps occur, model patience over anger—as a parent, teaching by example nurtures their inner wisdom and promotes long-term growth.
  • Leadership
    • Empower your team to follow what they believe is right and beneficial, fostering an environment where learning is valued over blame.
    • Adopt a measured, compassionate approach when errors happen; use these moments to instruct and clarify, reinforcing the values you wish to see in your organization.
  • Product Management
    • Encourage your team to embrace innovative ideas that resonate with their natural inclinations, understanding that what appears suitable at first may need thoughtful refinement.
    • When projects deviate from the intended path, lead by calmly educating rather than reprimanding, ensuring that lessons turn setbacks into stepping stones for future success.
